proposals.expected_signal: Improves frozen full-sort NDCG@10 if auxiliary contrast on sampled unobserved items reduces popularity-dominated embeddings and sharpens local neighborhoods without changing the ranking protocol.
proposals.failure_mode: Auxiliary contrast may over-separate semantically similar tail items, weakening collaborative smoothing and yielding flat or negative NDCG change.
proposals.hypothesis: On ML-1M, LightGCN-style propagation likely leaves item geometry partly popularity-biased. Adding a lightweight degree-aware contrastive auxiliary over sampled unobserved negatives should test whether representation debiasing, rather than deeper propagation or parameter retuning, is the missing mechanism.
